name: kb_1019_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: RollingUpdateStatefulSetStrategy is used to communicate parameter for RollingUpdateStatefulSetStrategyType.

partition.description: Partition indicates the ordinal at which the StatefulSet should be partitioned. Default value is 0.

schema.description: StatefulSetUpdateStrategy indicates the strategy that the StatefulSet controller will use to perform updates. It includes any additional parameters necessary to perform the update for the indicated strategy.

rollingUpdate.description: RollingUpdate is used to communicate parameters when Type is RollingUpdateStatefulSetStrategyType.

type.description: Type indicates the type of the StatefulSetUpdateStrategy. Default is RollingUpdate.

description: The StatefulSet is configured to use a **RollingUpdate** strategy for its updates. In this mode, the rollout will progress by updating pods incrementally, with the partition set to **3**, meaning that the first three replicas will remain at their current version while the remaining instances are upgraded. This configuration ensures a controlled, staged update process while maintaining service continuity.
